university_building.name: University Building
university_building.description: A large, labyrinthine building filled with classrooms and offices.

classroom.name: Professor Riddle's Classroom
classroom.description: An imposing classroom with old-fashioned furniture and dusty shelves.
classroom.image_prompt: aged magic professor classroom, fantasy art

final_exam_paper.name: Final Exam Paper for Professor Riddle’s Class
final_exam_paper.description: A carefully crafted exam paper designed to test Alyssa's understanding of the material.
final_exam_paper.image_prompt: exam paper with magical formulas, fantasy style

key3.name: Final Exam Key
key3.description: A special key that grants access to Professor Riddle’s final exam room and its contents.
key3.image_prompt: magic final exam key, fantasy art

professor.name: Professor Riddle
professor.description: The now-senior professor who has accepted Alyssa as a student and is eager to see her succeed.
professor.image_prompt: elderly wizard teacher, old-fashioned clothes, glasses

dialogues.before_talk: Riddle: You must solve this riddle before I grant you access to my final exam!
dialogues.after_talk: Alyssa: Professor, I have prepared for months. Do you think I am ready?
dialogues.after_satisfied: Riddle: Excellent work! Here is the key to your future.
dialogues.hostile: Riddle: Guards! This student must be tested!

alyssa.name: Alyssa
alyssa.description: The persistent and studious student who has been granted access to Professor Riddle's final exam room.
alyssa.image_prompt: determined student, looking at books with focus in her eyes

dialogues.before_talk: Alyssa: Thank you, professor. I am ready for the test now!
dialogues.after_talk: Alyssa: Professor, I have studied hard and completed the exam paper to your specifications.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Alyssa: Thank you! You see how much I have learned from your teachings.
dialogues.hostile: Riddle: Not yet, student. You must do better!
